name: Abstract Algebraic Constraints
description: Replaces the scheduling terminology (jobs, workstations, intervals, precedence) with a purely algebraic system of inequalities over real numbers. This forces models to logically deduce the arithmetic conditions for unsatisfiability ($p_1+p_2 > T$ and $\sum p_c > T$) rather than relying on memorized scheduling heuristics. It also creates a trap for models that attempt to use SMT solvers (like Z3) directly on the algebraic description, which will result in a Time Limit Exceeded error given the large input bounds.
